notes.title: New Uncensored Release - Yuri Visual Novel, Forest Guardian!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12668505/98ca23738fb545bc6ba53290456631cb03427e99.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

This is a quick update, just dropping in to let everyone know we've rolled out a new release, a fantasy yuri visual novel entitled "Forest Guardian". It's [b]completely uncensored[/b] and features around 5~ hours of gameplay and around 20 CGs. It also features foxgirls! It runs at $10.99, but will have a 10% discount for the next week.

Pick it up here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1181030/Forest_Guardian

notes.title: An Adventurer's Tale - Now Live on Steam! (w/ Free 18+ DLC Patch)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12668505/d2233e344baa4bda97b4475505472111cba9c83f.jpg[/img]

Happy to say that our latest project, VN/RPG hybrid An Adventurer's Tale, is now live on Steam!!! 

You can pick it up here for 15% off for the next week:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/942580/An_Adventurers_Tale/

and also grab the free 18+ mature patch if you're over 18:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1060520/An_Adventurers_Tale__Mature_Content_Patch/

Happy adventuring!
